items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: my mother decided to come back to Cincinnati and live with an aunt whose name was Mary... when we lived with my Aunt Mary.

ctx.x: About two years later, my mother decided to come back to Cincinnati and live with an aunt whose name was Mary. Aunt Mary smoked a pipe as did sommany women from the South. Kentucky is not what is called the deep South but the problems of the Negro were the same as those that existed in any of the other Southern states. I mentioned this because I mentioned my Aunt Mary smoking a pipe, as I said before most women from the South smoked pipes,even the white ones. Aunt Mary was also a great beer drinker. There was a…

and take it, fill it up for 5 cents, give it back to me under the swinging doors and also give me a handful of pretzels. I learned to do many useful things that have been very helpful to me in later years when we lived with my Aunt Mary. A child could not be lazy at the age of 8 years around her. So I had to sweep the floors, scrub the front and back steps every Saturday because we lived on the second floor. I also had to scrub and whiten the three front steps that led into the hall and I remember the product I…

Aunt Mary ruled me more so than my mother did and on Sunday afternoon, I was allowed to put on my special Sunday clothes and sit on the nice clean steps, if the weather was permissable, in the summer time.
